title: Three Tides | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Luxury WaterColor retreat with private pool, spa, and carriage house. Sleeps 12 with bikes, LSV, and Beach Club access—perfect for a 30A getaway.
description_expanded: Book Your Getaway Today & Save! Use Promo Code: THREETIDES20 at checkout for an exclusive introductory rate. For a limited time only. Holiday black out dates apply. Valid for arrival dates 3/16/26 - 5/22/26 Three Tides Luxury WaterColor Retreat with Private Pool, Spa & Carriage House Home Introduction Unwind in style at Three Tides , a spacious six-bedroom retreat designed for relaxing coastal escapes with family and friends. Featuring a private pool and spa, a separate carriage house, and generous indoor-outdoor living spaces, this beautifully appointed home offers everything needed for a memorable 30A getaway. With designer interiors, multiple balconies with daybed swings, and access to WaterColor's premier amenities-including the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor-Three Tides provides the perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and convenience for groups of up to 12 guests. The official photoshoot is coming soon! Home Highlights Private Pool & Spa - Pool heating included for arrivals October 1-April 30 6-Seater Electric Cart Company LSV - Included with stay (waiver required) 5 Complimentary Taxi Bikes for exploring 30A Outdoor Living Oasis - Screened-in lounge with TV, fireplace, dining for 6, and summer kitchen with built-in natural gas grill Two Second-Floor Balconies with relaxing daybed swings Gourmet Kitchen - Wolf and SubZero appliance Dining Seating for 13 - Table for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 5 Separate Carriage House - Living room, kitchenette, sleeper sofa, and private king suite Spacious Main Living Room - Smart TV and fireplace Covered Front Porch with classic rocking chairs Sleeping for 12 Guests - Five king suites plus guest room and sleeper sofa Laundry Room with HE washer and dryer Parking for 4 Vehicles in the driveway WaterColor Amenity Access - Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and community pools for guests age 5+ Complete Clean Linen Program - Fresh, professionally laundered linens for every stay Location Perks Access to the WaterColor Beach Club with towel service (subject to change by the neighborhood) Enjoy the pools and activities at Camp WaterColor Community pools heated during cooler months Minutes from 30A dining, shopping, and beach access Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10 nights or longer (included in your rate) Additional housekeeping services can be scheduled for an extra fee Concierge services available , including grocery delivery, beach service, baby equipment rentals, private chef experiences, and catered beach bonfires * One promotion or discount per reservation. Promotions or discounts cannot be combined
